flows.name: Buyer filters and books viewing inquiry
flows.steps: Home filter apartment+max 3m > 12+ listing candidates > open unit prop-01 > inspect images and plan > save/compare two alternatives > request a Tuesday preference > receipt request id (not confirmation) > admin view queue.
flows.oracle: Numeric filter and compare correct; unit ID bound to viewing request.

flows.name: Investor compares options
flows.steps: Developments > explore development > choose listing > add 3 compare > attempt 4th shows limit > print summary with sample disclaimers.
flows.oracle: No more than 3; compare list persists on refresh.

flows.name: Out of stock viewing rejected
flows.steps: Mark one seed unit unavailable > details show unavailable > request viewing action disabled/indicates alternative.
flows.oracle: Server refuses request for unavailable unit.

design: Luxury but legible editorial property publication. Stone #F5F0E6 / forest-charcoal #25312D / bronze #A8764F. Landscape visual edge, map/list rhythm, restrained serif accents, project identity panels; not generic cards or unsupported ROI badges.
signatureFeatures: Linked project/unit taxonomy with persistent multi-filters and query URL
Compare up to 3 properties including price/area/layout and exact differences
Mortgage/instalment estimator clearly labeled illustrative and non-financial advice
Photo gallery and floorplan viewer with true example dimensions labels
Request viewing with preference picker, status REQUESTED in operator console
seedRequirements: 5 fictional developments; 24 units across 5 types, 4 neighborhoods; 3 size ranges; 6 editorial location guides; 2 illustrative plans per development; 4+ visual assets per detail; some units unavailable and transparently flagged.
adminRequirements: Projects/developments, unit listings, prices, statuses, floor plans, galleries, neighborhood articles and incoming viewing requests. Admin changing property status immediately updates filters, comparison and request eligibility.
negativeScenarios: One 135 m² property with 2 beds and 1 bath, all contexts consistent
One unit status unavailable; viewing request blocked
Compare 3 then add fourth shows helpful feedback
Estimated monthly instalment formula displayed with input assumptions and disclaimers
